title: M5GFX #440 review: hold the panel init until 122 ms after the Core2/Tough LCD reset release

firmware.build: ESP-IDF v6.1, target esp32, examples/Test/build_test, harness-only main.cpp (evidence/harness-main.diff)

execution.environment: macOS arm64; ESP-IDF v6.1 + xtensa-esp32-elf; local Device Service core2 profile (qemu-esp32lx6/m5core2, ILI9342C-E 320x240, simulated, screenshot); no node/npm

checks.detail: PR #440 OPEN, not draft, author ainyan03, English; 0 comments and 0 reviews before this review; mergeable MERGEABLE
9 files, +114/-8 against develop tip 43a8719; only board detection, M5GFX init call sites and board_detect tests change
reset_panel_reload (1<<2) is set only on desc_core2:60 and desc_tough:75; description_valid() rejects it for non-i2c_regs resets and with reset_hold_when_skipped (prepare.inl:367-370)

RDDPM(0Ah) is read once before the reset and only while !reset_seen; (v & 0x18)==0x08 selects Normal Mode On with Sleep Out clear; a zero read is not Sleep In (board_registry.inl:120-148, esp32_d0wdq6.inl:495-503)

wait_panel_ready() is invoked at M5GFX.cpp:925 (fixed board) and M5GFX.cpp:1039 (adopted detection) immediately before _init_adopted_panel(), i.e. before the panel init list; deadline is release+122 ms so detection/NVS time counts (detection_integration.inl:226-239, prepare.inl:539-552)
reset_seen is set on assert and when the power list releases a held reset, so a retry cannot treat a reloading panel as Sleep In; a stale deadline is ignored when left <= 0 or > 122
test/board_detect/run.sh at PR head: 34/34 C++ test programs passed, including new core_panel_sleep_in() (4 cases, read-count asserts)
40/40 upstream checks passed (Arduino esp32 2.0.17/3.1.3/3.3.13/4.0.0, C3/C5/C6/H2/P4, ESP-IDF 5.1.6/5.4.3/6.0.2, catalog, host, translation-unit)

PR firmware boots on the Core2 profile: rst POWERON, Autodetect M5StackCore2, board=2, init ok=1, expected 320x240 frame; frame sha256 22fe80fc70999a09b53a6e09109d358f61a0abb9a52cdab283d581cb79ab3356 is identical to the base build; init 328333 us vs 328330 us

the 122 ms wait did not fire on the model: the ILI9342 sink has no RDDPM read (SPI reads return 0x7f) and no reload window, so the post-reset identify_panel_variant(120 ms) consumes the deadline first
no Core2/Tough hardware on this host; the alternating blank and the four-board timing table are the author's evidence in the PR body, not measured here
the emulator's ILI9342 sink models sleep as a plain flag (0x10/0x11) with no reset-to-Sleep-In transition and no register reload, so the issue #438 failure cannot be represented
extras/board_spec npm test / npm run check need node/npm, not installed here; covered by the upstream Catalog and generated sources job
non-blocking: no host test drives apply_reset()/wait_panel_ready() with a fake clock, so the 122 ms deadline and the Sleep In skip are not asserted end to end; suggested follow-up

non-blocking: run_detection_session() promotes allow_reset=true when attempt+2==max_attempts (detect_types.hpp:171), so init_without_reset() can reset and wait on M5GFX::begin()'s 4th/5th attempt; PR body wording says it never does, M5GFX.h:304-305 already documents the promotion

notes: PR left OPEN; exactly one English comment posted; no close, no push, no change to m5stack/M5GFX or the author's fork.
Evidence classes used: virtual-device validation (Core2 non-regression only), host-level test (board_detect suite), upstream CI, code-level verification. Hardware validation is NOT RUN.
The virtual run cannot show that the blank is fixed; the model has no reload window and no RDDPM read. This limit is stated in the public comment and README.
No blocking issue found. Two non-blocking notes: wait-path test coverage and the init_without_reset() wording.
